test.title: Air pollution in cities: causes and solutions

document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
after: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

text: Air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities around the world. It makes the air dirty, and it can cause many illnesses. In this essay, I will explain the main causes of this problem and suggest some solutions. I believe that this problem can be solved if governments and citizens act together.

There are several causes of air pollution. The first and most important one is traffic. In big cities, millions of people drive cars every day, and the cars produce a lot of smoke. Another cause is industry. Many factories are built near cities, and they put harmful gases into the air. In addition, in some countries, people burn coal and wood to heat their homes in winter, which makes the air even worse. The result is that the air in many cities is full of dust and chemicals.

There are also some solutions. Firstly, governments should improve public transport, so that people can use buses and trains instead of cars. If the tickets are cheap and the buses are frequent, many people will leave their cars at home. Secondly, cities can build more bicycle lanes, because cycling is healthy and does not produce any pollution. Thirdly, factories should be moved outside the city, and they should use filters to clean the smoke. Finally, governments can give money to people who change to clean energy for heating, for example solar panels.

In conclusion, traffic, industry and heating are the main causes of air pollution in cities. However, if governments improve public transport, build cycle lanes and control factories, the air will become cleaner and people will be healthier.
